message.content:
**rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) – allele frequency in European populations**

| Population group | Allele frequency (C allele) | Source |
|------------------|-----------------------------|--------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.15 (15 %)** | gnomAD |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.07 (7 %)** | gnomAD |
| All Europeans combined (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.12 (12 %)** | gnomAD |

> **Key points**
> - rs7412 is one of the two SNPs that define the APOE ε2/ε3/ε4 alleles.  
> - The C allele at rs7412 is characteristic of the ε2 allele, which is associated with a lower risk of Alzheimer’s disease but higher risk of type III hyperlipoproteinemia.  
> - Frequencies vary by sub‑population; Finnish Europeans have a notably lower frequency than other European groups.  
> - These figures come from the gnomAD database (v2.1.1), which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from >140,000 individuals.  

**Note:** Allele frequencies can shift slightly as new data are added to public databases. If you need the most up‑to‑date numbers, consult the latest release of gnomAD or other population‑genetics resources such as the 1000 Genomes Project.
